name: Random Address
description: Random US name, address, phone and email for signup forms, offline. Optional Firefox Relay or DuckDuckGo aliases.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src https://relay.firefox.com https://quack.duckduckgo.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
